2017 ACURA NSX

NORD GRAY, CARBON FIBER ENGINE COVER, MISHIMOTO EXHAUST, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2017 Acura NSX is a hybrid supercar that fuses precision engineering with cutting-edge performance technology. It carries forward the legacy of the original NSX and modernizes it through a groundbreaking hybrid powertrain and peerless Japanese craftsmanship. Mounted mid-rear is a 3.5-liter twin-turbocharged V6, paired with a trio of electric motors that form Acura's Super Handling All-Wheel Drive system. Together, they produce a combined 573 horsepower and 476 lb-ft of torque, channeled through a 9-speed dual-clutch transmission. The result is instant torque, seamless power delivery, and 0-60 mph in just 2.9 seconds. The exterior showcases an aggressive yet refined design with sculpted aero, large air intakes, and a low-slung stance. Lightweight materials including advanced composite panels and a hollow aluminum spaceframe provide structure without excess weight. Adaptive magnetorheological dampers, double-wishbone front suspension, and mid-engine balance deliver handling that's confidence-inspiring. Inside, the NSX offers a driver-focused cockpit where luxury complements purpose. Leather-trimmed sport seats create an environment built for feedback and comfort alike. Alcantara accents enhance the sporty feel, while a premium audio system and Apple CarPlay keep you connected and in-tune. Despite more powerful rivals in today's growing EV market, the NSX remains a rare hybrid supercar that delivers instant electric torque, all-season usability, and credible lap performance on a track.

The 2017 Porsche 911 Carrera S (991.2 generation) is a masterclass in modern sports car engineering, marking a historic shift from natural aspiration to turbocharging for the Carrera line. This example, finished in timeless GT Silver Metallic, represents the pinnacle of the "everyday supercar" with a perfect balance of track-ready performance and daily usability. This specific configuration is highly desirable, featuring essential performance hardware alongside luxury-oriented packages that enhance every aspect of the driving experience.
Performance
The 991.2 Carrera S features a 3.0L twin-turbocharged flat-six engine producing 420 horsepower and 368 lb-ft of torque. When equipped with the Sport Package, the car gains Rear-Axle Steering (RAS), which significantly improves high-speed stability and decreases the turning radius at low speeds. The addition of Sport Exhaust provides a more visceral soundtrack, while the Sport Chrono Package includes dynamic engine mounts and a mode switch on the steering wheel, allowing the S to sprint from 0–60 mph in as little as 3.7 seconds.
Design
This 911 is draped in GT Silver Metallic, a color that highlights the 991.2's refined exterior cues, such as the vertical slats on the rear decklid and the four-point LED daytime running lights. The inclusion of Sport Design side mirrors provides a more aggressive, aerodynamic profile compared to the standard units. The sleek silhouette is further complemented by the "S" model's slightly wider rear track and standard 20-inch wheels, giving it a planted, muscular stance.
Technology
Inside, the Porsche Communication Management (PCM) system offers a crisp 7-inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay integration and online navigation. The Premium Package Plus adds a layer of modern convenience with Porsche Entry & Drive (keyless access) and an auto-dimming mirror system. The 12.3-inch instrument cluster display provides the driver with real-time performance data, navigation maps, and vehicle settings, ensuring that high-tech functionality is always within the driver’s line of sight.
Advanced Safety Features
Safety and driver assistance are well-represented through the Porsche Dynamic Light System (PDLS), which provides active cornering lights that adjust based on steering angle and speed. The car is equipped with a comprehensive airbag system and Porsche Stability Management (PSM), which has been specifically tuned for the 991.2 to allow for more spirited driving while maintaining a safety net.

description: The 2014 Audi R8 V8 quattro, VIN WUAAUAFGXEN002676, is a striking example of Audis mid-engine supercar finished in Iris White over a black leather interior. This model represents the final evolution of the first-generation R8 before the second generation arrived, and it is especially desirable among enthusiasts for its naturally aspirated 4.2-liter FSI V8 engine. Producing 430 horsepower at approximately 7,900 rpm and 317 lb-ft of torque around 4,500 rpm, the high-revving V8 delivers linear throttle response and an unmistakable exhaust note that defines the character of this car. Power is sent through Audis quattro all-wheel-drive system, providing exceptional grip and balance thanks to its mid-engine layout, making it equally confident on spirited back roads or high-speed highway driving. For 2014, the R8 received updated LED headlights and subtle exterior refinements that sharpened its already exotic presence. The crisp Iris White paint highlights the sculpted body lines, signature side blades, and aggressive air intakes that have made the R8 an icon in the modern supercar world. Inside, the black leather cabin blends luxury with performance, offering supportive sport seats, premium materials, and Audis MMI infotainment system with navigation and Bluetooth connectivity. The automatic transmission available in this model year, typically Audis R tronic automated manual or the later S tronic dual clutch depending on build configuration, delivers quick paddle-controlled shifts while maintaining everyday drivability. Performance remains a major highlight, with 0 to 60 mph acceleration in the low four second range and a top speed approaching 188 mph in coupe form. Enthusiasts appreciate the 2014 R8 V8 not only for its performance figures but for its analog, naturally aspirated driving experience that predates the widespread shift to turbocharged supercars. Audi Rancho Mirage is delighted to showcase, this Pre-Owned 2024 Audi S5 Coupe Premium Plus. Dressed in a striking Chronos Gray Metallic exterior and complemented by a bold Black interior with Crescendo Red stitching, this sophisticated sport coupe has just 20,767 miles to its name. It stands as a compelling fusion of performance, precision engineering, and modern Audi luxury.

The S5 Coupes athletic proportions and sculpted lines are enhanced by the Black Optic Plus Package, featuring 20" 5-twin-spoke polygon design wheels in bi-color finish, black exterior trim, black Audi rings and badges, and black exhaust tips for an unmistakably aggressive presence. The S Sport Package adds red brake calipers and a sport adaptive damping suspension, reinforcing its dynamic character. A Black Roof and signature Matrix-design LED headlights complete the coupes bold and contemporary aesthetic.


Step inside and you are greeted by a driver-focused cabin wrapped in premium materials. The Fine Nappa Leather Seats paired with the Audi Sport Interior Package showcase Crescendo red stitching and RS Carbon inlays, creating a refined yet performance-inspired atmosphere. • Premium Plus Package: Advanced driver assistance, Bang & Olufsen 3D sound, top view camera, and enhanced connectivity features.

• Black Optic Plus Package: 20" bi-color wheels, black exterior accents, and black exhaust tips for a bold aesthetic.

Convenience
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

This stunning 2017 Ford Mustang GT Premium is the perfect blend of raw power and refined sophistication. With its potent 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine and 6-speed manual transmission, this Mustang delivers an exhilarating driving experience that will leave you craving more. Beyond these impressive features, this Mustang GT Premium offers a wealth of premium amenities that will elevate your driving experience.
